thread:
lucy: After the RFC, quick proposal for a per-customer fallback contract when we flip CP peering -> private endpoint. Need something lightweight and reversible. Thoughts?

 tom: +1. Keep it simple: dual-accept for the window, control plane marks primary, agent reports fallback_count.

 priya: Two top risks: src-ip changes and BGP route churn. If src-ip changes mid-session customer's ACLs could drop traffic.

 nathan: For src-ip we support two modes: advertise tenant egress IP (ENI/EIP) or sticky SNAT. Default to sticky SNAT, ENI opt-in for large customers. Document ops cost.

 lucy: Also add a preflight probe that validates egress ACLs before moving. If probe fails we don't start the window and we inform SE.

 tom: Token handling: issue a grace bootstrap token TTL = window + 10m so agents don't rotate away. Agent should expose accepted_modes=[peering,private] and active_primary.

 priya: BGP: staged withdraw per-region. Provide recommended wait windows per provider and automate waves. No global withdraw at once.

 nathan: Observability: primary_choice, fallback_rate, probe_success_pct, nat_churn. Add console rollback button to flip primary per-tenant.

 ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-08 09:00 to review the playbook. :bell:

 lucy: I'll draft the playbook with default gates and agent TTLs and post here. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
